retouches.prompt: Remove two things from this picture and change nothing else. First, remove the sleeping ginger-and-white cat from the armchair: fill its spot by continuing the cream knitted blanket with its sage-green fern motif over the seat, and the muted olive-green seat cushion beneath it, following the existing folds, wrinkles and soft shading. Second, remove the small brown songbird standing on the windowsill: show the wooden sill, the window frame and the lake-and-forest view continuing behind where it stood. Preserve the picture exactly as it is everywhere else: the same soft, muted, low-saturation colours, the same warm evening lighting, the same gentle dithered pixel shading and the same level of detail as the original. Do not brighten, saturate, flatten, sharpen, clean up or restyle the armchair, the blanket, the wool basket, the firewood, the potted plant, the vines or the window. No cat, no bird, no animal, no human, no fingers, no skin.
